notes: 4 plates of 96 wells: the 4 genes in 1 panel × the 12 samples in 4 batches; every sample in 2 replicates per assay.
Every plate carries the reference genes (ALUsq(Eurogentec), HMBS, HPRT1, SDHA(1), UBC(2)) for its own samples, so each sample is normalised within its plate.
A gene's samples span plates, so the same inter-run calibrator (IRC) is on every plate for every assay: it links the runs (Hellemans 2007).
Samples are dealt to plates group by group in a random order (seeded), and shuffled within each plate, so neither plate nor position is group.
